title: Genesis structured turn plan v2 (CC-009 candidate, noncanonical)
description: An ordered, editable plan of one actor's activities. It is an AUTHORED INTENTION: it confers no authority and records no outcome. turn_plan_v2.js turns it into a turn-contract/3 declaration; the existing validator authorizes; only committed GM/Atomic events carry outcomes.

actor.description: Turn owner. Must equal the published context's actor.

based_on.description: The published context the plan was written against. A mismatch is STALE_PLAN; the processor's own revision/ledger-head check (turn.py check) still applies.

end_turn.description: Only the player's explicit word ends a turn while budget remains. A submission alone never does.

whisper.description: Passed through untouched; governed by the WHISPER contract (TB4_WHISPER_001).

slot.description: Action-economy slot. 'secondary' is refused (SECONDARY_NOT_ENABLED) unless the published context carries ruleset.secondary_action === true. 'reaction' is a declared intent with a trigger; it is never a turn step.

text.description: Custom intent, kept literally. The GM adjudicates its cost and effect.

id.description: A visible id from the context; never a hidden one.

extended.description: An extended exchange takes the action (ACTION_ECONOMY_RULING §2).

trigger.description: Reactions: the event that would trigger it.

condition.description: Execute only if this is settled by committed events; otherwise the GM stops there (a halt) and the rest becomes pending.

after.description: Activities this one depends on; each must come earlier (DEPENDENCY_ORDER).

status.description: For pending activities: the published status (interrupted, unattempted, paused...).
